**About The Role**
**Senior AI Engineer – Generative AI & LLMs**
At Avathon, we are building cutting-edge AI solutions that transform operations across asset-intensive industries such as Supply Chain, Logistics, Energy, Mining, Aerospace, and Industrial Manufacturing. As an AI Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable AI systems with a strong focus on Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and production-grade machine learning applications.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone with strong engineering depth who can bridge research and production—building robust AI platforms, optimizing LLM workflows, and delivering high-impact solutions across forecasting, route optimization, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, and intelligent automation.
  
  
With 3–5 years of hands-on industry experience, you are expected to bring expertise in AI system design, ML engineering, LLM deployment, and scalable software development within fast-paced startup environments.
  
  
You Will
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI/ML systems with strong emphasis on Generative AI and LLM-powered applications
* Develop and optimize end-to-end LLM pipelines including RAG architectures, fine-tuning, prompt orchestration, evaluation, and observability
* Build scalable backend services and APIs for AI applications using modern engineering best practices
* Implement and productionize transformer-based models and GenAI workflows for enterprise use cases
* Design vector search systems, embedding pipelines, and retrieval frameworks for knowledge-intensive applications
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions
* Drive experimentation, benchmarking, model evaluation, and performance optimization with scientific rigor
* Improve inference efficiency, latency optimization, cost management, and reliability of deployed AI systems
* Establish guardrails, hallucination detection, monitoring, and responsible AI practices for production deployments
* Contribute to MLOps workflows including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, observability, and cloud deployment
* Stay current with the latest advancements in LLMs, agentic systems, foundation models, and applied AI engineering

You'll Have
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field
* 3–5 years of hands-on industry experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Applied AI, or related roles
* Strong experience building and deploying LLM-based applications in production environments
* Solid expertise with Python and modern AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar
* Strong understanding of transformer architectures, LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG systems, and vector databases
* Experience building scalable APIs and backend systems supporting AI workflows
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Strong software engineering fundamentals including system design, debugging, performance optimization, and production reliability
* Experience with containerization, deployment pipelines, and collaborative engineering environments
* Strong analytical thinking, ownership mindset, and ability to work in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments
* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with technical and business stakeholder

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, or embedding-based search systems
* Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases)
* Hands-on experience with practical LLM deployment -- prompt versioning, cost/latency tracking, guardrails, or hallucination detection
* Exposure to LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval) or LLM-as-judge evaluation patterns
* Basic understanding of MLOps practices and model lifecycle management
* Experience working on applied AI projects in academic, internship, or startup settings
* Interest in industrial AI and asset-intensive environments
* Industry exposure in one or more of the following domains: Mining, Oil & Gas, Aerospace, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Renewable Energy

Forward Deployment AI Engineer
Lyra Technology Group is a group of over 130 managed IT service providers (MSPs) serving over 10,000 clients and managing over 300,000 end user devices across the US, Canada, the UK, Europe, Australia and New Zealand. We're hiring several Forward Deployment AI Engineers (FDEs) to develop and deploy Vega, our proprietary AI Operating System, across our MSP operating companies.
We’re building a team of enterprising, ambitious engineers who are as fulfilled tracking down a tricky bug as they are watching their work transform a business. You’ll drive new feature development and deployment into our operating companies. You’ll be on-site, learning how their teams work, connecting the platform to their systems, changing day-to-day workflows, and proving the impact in dollars.
What you'll own
Innovation and product: build features across the stack, close integration gaps, and fix what breaks, including a turn on call for production. We’re building from zero to one, and innovation across the stack is a mandate.
Discovery : map how each business works, find the opportunities with the highest return, and flag local solutions worth turning into shared capabilities.
Deployments, end to end : onboard new operating companies, integrate with their tools, and get front-line teams using the platform every day.
Integrations : build connectors to the ticketing systems and other tools our businesses run on, behind one shared layer, so the agents work the same way at each business.
Agentic workflows : design agents with tool use, memory and multi-agent orchestration for triage, enrichment, root-cause analysis and proactive support.
Earning trust : be the technical advisor each customer's leaders and front-line staff rely on, translate AI into business value, and earn the operational changes the platform depends on.
Enablement : train the AI engineers placed at our operating companies, their local AI leads and front-line teams to run the platform day to day and adapt it to their workflows, while you keep owning the product underneath.
Reporting results : set baselines, measure impact and cost, and report to leadership on what's working and what isn't.
Requirements
Adaptability: no business process or requirement is too messy. You have no ego and would be happy shadowing IT techs working in disparate systems for hours on end and leveraging that experience to build organized agent systems.
Communication that fits the audience: you can walk a CFO through benefits and use cases and go deep on implementation with fellow engineers.
A strong track record of shipping software that real users depend on, and owning it after launch.
Hands-on experience working on AWS-hosted systems.
Full-stack fluency in TypeScript/Node and React, or a strong background in another language (Python, Java, C#, Go) and the appetite to switch.
Integration experience with third-party APIs: auth flows, rate limits, webhooks and messy data.
You’ve shipped AI-driven products and have production experience with LLMs, agentic products/features, building evals, and proper governance.
Agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar), and the judgment to know when AI-written code is safe to merge.
You don't need to have worked in IT services. You do need to learn an unfamiliar business quickly.
Preferred
Experience in IT services or managed service operations, or with ticketing systems such as ConnectWise, HaloPSA or Autotask.
Relational database depth, and experience keeping each customer's data separate with access control and audit trails.
MCP servers, modern agent frameworks, and security and privacy work such as data residency and PII handling.
Who thrives here
You own a number, not just a feature. You set a baseline, measure the impact, and kill what doesn't pay.
You treat cost as a product input. Model spend, compute and per-customer margin are part of your design decisions.
You'd rather build once for many businesses than build bespoke for one.
You find messy problems energizing. Integrations break, data is messy, and the customer's real process rarely matches the documentation.
You're comfortable with ambiguity and a small team, and you'd rather spend a day being scrappy than writing a spec.
You work independently in the field but build as a team. You review each other's code, share what each deployment taught you, and ask for help before a local fix becomes a fork.
Compensation and location
$160,000 - $200,000 base salary (DOE), plus discretionary annual bonus potential. Hybrid, based in our NYC office, with up to 25% travel to operating companies.
If you want to build AI that service-desk teams at over 130 businesses use every day, and be in the room when it lands, we'd like to hear from you!
